player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ocinimbu eci ka ca sungulukile. Pole, o sukila oku ci soneha ndoco: [<number>] .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kulunga ina kwela kalaashiwa kuwa ni kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
message.round_draw: Oku imba ombunje ca soka ndoku yekela.

outcome.p0_wins: Omunu wa yulula, eye o kuete vali epondolo lioku yula.
outcome.p1_wins: Omunu watete, o tambula oloñoma vialua.
